flows.about: Story DT308.1, DT308.9 and DT308.10 (0.3.157, boards Stories236 and Stories241; Coach Milan, Go 18 November 11:14): the meal line and Fit with no meal set. A new plate says No meal selected, in grey, with a pencil, and nothing is counted or planned. No meal is guessed when a food lands. The pencil opens your calendar: the days on top, that day's meals with their time and state, as the last row Just looking, and under them What is it? and Chef Mealan's What kind of moment?, as they were. A tap on a meal sets the meal and the day and closes it; a tap on a chip keeps it open; the pencil closes it with no meal set. Once set, the line says the meal, then the day, date and time, and the moment when it is not a regular meal, and an X stands in the pencil's place: it clears the meal and the day, and the moment is Regular meal again. With no meal set, Fit to my target aims only at your PD target: the result says This plate, and Chef Mealan says first what Fit aimed at. The checks name the rows of the build brief (A1 to A8, B1, B2). Changed by B150 (0.3.160, board B150; Go 19 November 01:00): the line says No meal selected under the small title Meal and day, in ink; the pencil is always there and is the X that closes while edit mode is open; a tap on a meal keeps edit mode open; the row No meal selected, marked while no meal is set, took the place of Just looking and of the X that cleared.
